queries_run: Palantir new entrant OR displace threat competitor 2026

findings.claim: 10-K 載明公司主要與客戶內部自研軟體競爭，對手包括大型企業軟體商、政府承包商與系統整合商，並有新進與既有公司持續進入此市場。
findings.excerpt: We are fundamentally competing with the internal software development efforts of our potential customers.

findings.claim: 10-K 風險因子警告大型對手可能以搭售、零或負毛利等方式競爭，並可能導致訂單減少、毛利下降與市占流失。
findings.source: SEC EDGAR 10-K FY2025 Item 1A Risk Factors
findings.excerpt: Increased competition could result in fewer customer orders, price reductions, reduced margins, and loss of market share, any of which could harm our business and results of operations.

competitive_share_entrants.note: 搜尋未找到第三方量化市占數據；以下僅列有網址線索（前沿AI實驗室、Alphabet 國防協議、Neo4j、Anduril 等為新進入者說法，多為聚合/意見稿，實際流失訂單證據薄弱）。

clues.claim: Trefis：AI 模型實驗室也想要同樣的企業客戶，既是供應商也是對手；Q2 客戶數字未見影響。
clues.source: Trefis What Are Palantir Stock Bulls Not Worried About?

clues.claim: Barchart：Alphabet 與美國國防部簽署機密協議，對 Palantir 等既有承包商形成競爭壓力。
clues.source: Barchart Why Palantir suddenly looks vulnerable after Google's move
